metadata.title: Continuation and convergence for the higher dimensional conformal Chern--Calabi flow
metadata.abstract: We study the volume-normalized gradient flow of the squared Chern scalar curvature on compact Hermitian manifolds of complex dimension $n\ge3$. The flow extends smoothly past a finite time if the spatial supremum of Chern scalar curvature belongs to $L^2$ in time. A uniform curvature bound in the evolving $L^p$ norm, for one fixed $p>n$, gives global existence and smooth convergence of the whole trajectory to a constrained critical metric. On Chern scalar-flat backgrounds, small initial $L^p$ curvature gives exponential convergence to the background. A corresponding condition on the trace-free first Chern--Ricci form gives exponential convergence on Chern--Ricci-flat Hermitian and positive Kähler--Einstein backgrounds. The smallness thresholds are independent of the initial higher derivatives. We also construct constant Chern scalar curvature backgrounds of either sign with arbitrarily small smooth perturbations whose solutions, if global, cannot converge back to the background.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究复维数 n≥3 的紧 Hermitian 流形上、平方 Chern 标量曲率的体积归一化共形梯度流。
techniques: 四阶抛物方程与指数稳定性
analysis.breakthrough: 空间曲率上确界在时间上 L² 可积可保证有限时延拓；某个 p>n 的演化 Lp 曲率统一界导出全局存在及整条轨道收敛，并给出小曲率指数收敛条件。
analysis.limitations: p>n 中 n 是复维数；全局收敛有统一曲率界假设。扰动反例只说解若全局便不能回到原背景，并不直接证明有限时爆破。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 将延拓、稳定与不稳定机制置于同一流中。
